pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, non-convex dark brown regions characterized by high-frequency jagged edge gradients and deeply incised, star-like perimeter geometry.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological network of light-colored pathways with a high density of tri-point junction nodes and consistent pixel thickness across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dense, short mane along the dorsal neck and shoulder line with a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian subject (oxpecker) on the mid-neck and a prominent vertical skin fold descending through the shoulder region.
